intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Nixa for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from December 4 (the Nixa Mayor's Tree Lighting Ceremony) through December 6 (the 72nd Nixa Christmas Parade), with the Cassidy Station Holiday Market at Estes Farms (December 5) in between. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Nixa

  • 3 Christmas events for kids in Nixa
  • 2 free events, the Nixa Mayor's Tree Lighting Ceremony and the 72nd Nixa Christmas Parade
  • Meet Santa: cocoa, cookies and Santa photos at the tree lighting (December 4) and Santa on a parade float (December 6)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the tree lighting at McCauley Park (December 4) and the Nixa Christmas Parade (December 6)
  • Markets: the Cassidy Station Holiday Market at Estes Farms (December 5)
  • Season: December 4 to December 6
